name.ja: ポケモンプラモコレクション No.41 セレクトシリーズ ピカチュウ
name.en: Pokemon Plastic Model Collection No.41 Select Series Pikachu

description.ja: • ポケモンプラモコレクション セレクトシリーズに可動満載のピカチュウが登場！
description.en: • Pokémon plastic model collection Select series now includes fully movable Pikachu!

description.ja: • 耳、首、手、尻尾、足の可動が大幅アップ！
description.en: • The movement of ears, neck, hands, tail, and feet has been greatly improved!

description.ja: • かわいいおすわりポーズや劇中で印象的なZワザポーズなど様々なポーズが再現可能に！
description.en: • A variety of poses can be recreated, including the cute sitting pose and the impressive Z-move pose from the movie!

description.ja: • 表情パーツもやる気満々に表情とかわいいにっこり表情の2種付属。
description.en: • Two types of expression parts are included: a motivated expression and a cute smiling expression.
